value.rationale: The probe-coupled third product stage has intrinsically different sampling variance than the first two, requiring nonuniform budget allocation even on a canonical incoherent low-rank spectral-moment benchmark. The exact saturation frontier is operationally motivated and the nonzero large-dimension variance gap (1+3/P against 1+1/P) demonstrates substantive rather than tiny improvement. No claim of graph-adjacency optimality.
